faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KBCNMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KBCNMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 1 Professor of Practice - School of Chemical Science, 1 Professor of Practice - School of Life Sciences, 1 Professor of Practice - University Institute of Chemical Technology, 1 Professor of Practice - School of Computer Sciences, 1 Professor of Practice - Language Studies and Research Centre, 1 Professor of Practice - School of Social Sciences and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KBCNMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 October 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 2000 per contact hour up to Rs. 90,000 per semester for Professor of Practice - School of Chemical Science, Rs. 2000 per contact hour up to Rs. 90,000 per semester for Professor of Practice - School of Life Sciences, Rs. 2000 per contact hour up to Rs. 90,000 per semester for Professor of Practice - University Institute of Chemical Technology, Rs. 2000 per contact hour up to Rs. 90,000 per semester for Professor of Practice - School of Computer Sciences, Rs. 2000 per contact hour up to Rs. 90,000 per semester for Professor of Practice - Language Studies and Research Centre.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Distinguished experts with remarkable contributions in their professions with at least 15 years of service/experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Not open for those in teaching profession - serving or retired. Mere eligibility will not vest any right on any candidate for being called for interview/interaction. Decision of the University in all matters will be final.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Serving or retired persons from the teaching profession.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting by the university based on requirements. Interview / Interaction. Shortlisting and interview/interaction process.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement will be for one year initially. Extendable by one year in exceptional cases, total service shall not exceed four years under any circumstances.
